name: treg
description: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn
one_liner: A single subscription-free gateway that lets an AI agent pay a few cents to use thousands of paid business tools (SEO data, scraping, enrichment, image generation) instead of you signing up for dozens of $99/month tools yourself.
buyer: An AI agency or indie developer building client-facing AI agents who needs access to dozens of paid data/tool APIs without paying for dozens of separate subscriptions upfront.
business_use_cases: An AI marketing agency builds a client-reporting agent that pulls SEO and backlink data pay-per-call through it instead of buying a $139/month Semrush seat per client.
A solo developer builds a lead-enrichment side project that calls company/people-enrichment endpoints per lookup instead of committing to an Apollo subscription.
A dev team gives every engineer's coding agent safe, centralized access to the team's internal tools and paid API keys without the credentials ever touching an individual laptop.

money_ideas.idea: Build a vertical AI agent product (e.g. an SEO research agent) priced per-use on top of it and keep the margin between your price and treg's per-call cost.
Resell 'bring your own team keys' gateway setup as a service to agencies that want centralized, auditable tool access for their staff's agents.

steal_this: Pick one expensive tool category (like backlink data) that a niche of freelancers needs occasionally, build a thin one-off 'ask a question, get a report' agent on top of treg's pay-per-call pricing, and sell single reports for a flat fee.
